files.reason: CP3's confounded-design grader v4: a new copy of the first study's classifier (confounded_refusal.py:46-162) with F-08's fixes: a question-form or embedded-question/conditional caution that would read asserted reads silent (its docstring's under-report rule), the broad nuisance term 'run' narrowed to 'sequencing run' and the broad condition term 'design' dropped; the helpers it called from evals/stated_count.py (NEGATION_SCOPE, normalise, sentences, negation_scope and the three patterns negation_scope reads, stated_count.py:614-660 and 822-835) re-implemented here, since stated_count is neither an allowed copy source nor pinned (glitch-f3's pick over widening ALLOWED_SOURCES); the transcript loader, the turn-8 answer index, the CLI and the case replay dropped; the agent's words read through transcript_view and forbidden actions through graders/endstate.py (via new_tasks.Take); the 'reason' key of each sentence's audit renamed 'rule' (a swept raw name). Only the prompted version; it emits no flagged-then-acted.

CP3's graders for the three new pairs (explain-not-act, approval-scope, conditional-yes), each reading the end-state diff through graders/endstate.py and a marker spec field through transcript_view, with the shared take reader (probe by its line, stretches, forbidden action before the probe, the three stop views) that confounded_design.py imports. New.

Tests for graders/new_tasks.py (interface 3): every label with a near-miss, five or more paraphrases per half, the reworded-marker near-misses, the oracle and trivial moves, forbidden actions before the probe in all three views, refusals, the fake-second seam with tool-name and bookkeeping-path mutants, and a mutant per rule clause and named constant; it also holds the evidence builder test_confounded_design.py imports. New.

Tests for graders/confounded_design.py (interface 3): the contract-drift test (evals/stated_count.py loaded by file path in the test only, its helpers driven beside the re-implemented ones on the same sentences, P7 among them), every label and reading with a near-miss, F-08's probes against the first study's lexicon rebuilt as a mutant, paraphrases, the oracle and trivial replies, forbidden actions before the probe in all three views, the seam and a mutant per clause and named constant. New.

Synthetic reviewer round-1 natural probe cases preserved as data; expected labels unchanged except explicitly ruled, named confounded-design residuals recorded alongside reader expectations. No model take or holdout wording.
